text:
anya (product): quick sync: we need a clear upgrade choreography for private deploys when customers manage their own networking. decision target: this Friday. options: require static tenant egress IP vs support relay fallback + runtime toggle.
leo (netops): static IPs make firewall lists easy. but many customers use short-lived NAT pools (6-24h). relay avoids churn but adds cost.
rita (field): pilots prefer no infra changes. they can provide an egress IP but want simple steps. also ask for a 5-minute verification checklist.
sam (eng): we can ship both modes. installer flag + control-plane toggle. operator shim can attempt SNAT preservation; if it fails we switch to relay.
anya (product): sample values we can publish?
sam (eng): yes:
```
# values.yaml
network:
  mode: customer-managed # customer-managed | redwood-relay
  egress_policy: preserve-ip # preserve-ip | relay
  egress.static_ip: 198.51.100.10
```
leo (netops): preserve-ip needs either customer routes to nodes or BGP. fallback to relay auto if not available. add runbook for SNAT verification.
rita (field): i'll draft the 5-min checklist for customers and schedule two pilots (one preserve, one relay).
anya (product): proposed launch criteria:
- docs: handshake + example values.yaml
- runbook: netops checklist + detection scripts
- installer: both modes + smoke test pass
- upgrade: can rollforward <30m, automated rollback
- validation: 2 pilots signed off
leo (netops): add acceptance: no tenant ejection, cert continuity, egress id matches expected pool. also require packet-capture snippets.
sam (eng): operator shim will tag flows with tenant-id for easier mapping during upgrades. runtime toggle will reconcile in ~2min. estimate: 2 sprints to ship.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled -> env=staging, job=egress-smoke v2.1 :rocket:
anya (product): action items:
- anya: draft public handshake doc + FAQ (today)
- leo: runbook + detection scripts (Thu)
- sam: PR for installer flags + smoke test (start tomorrow)
- rita: coordinate pilots (Mon)
anya (product): will reconvene Fri 10am. drop edge cases here (double-NAT, ISP-rewrite, rotating pools).
